gui.guildmark.cook.menu.request.known: Requests are for cooks the innkeeper knows.
message.guildmark.cook.door.owed: %s's payment has reached you: %s for your %s.
message.guildmark.cook.door.sold.carry: Sold %s %s %s. Not a whole Mark yet: you carry %s of one to your next sale here.
message.guildmark.cook.door.request: That counts toward the day's request: paid extra.
message.guildmark.cook.door.request.lock: The day's request is kept for cooks the innkeeper knows: paid as any dish.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.verdict_: Hm. One flavour is rather loud.
Nearly there, but there's too much of one thing.
Good, but it wants a little something.
Nearly there. It wants a bit more of one thing.
Now that is how it's done.
It's food. I'll give it that.
I've tasted better, and I've tasted worse.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.tier_hal: I'll be telling people about this one.
That is the best I have had in years.
I haven't tasted the like in years.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.first_0: That's new from you. Here's a little extra.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.first_1: Something new from you! A little extra for it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.first_2: First of those from you. Here's a little extra.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.full_0: We've plenty of that already today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.full_1: I couldn't sell another bowl of that today.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.full_2: The larder's full of that one, I'm afraid.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.stale_0: That's past its best, so I'll pay less.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.stale_1: It's a day or two old. I can pay less for it.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.gone_1: I can't take that. It's turned.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.baker_no: That's not for me. Try the innkeeper.
I only take what comes out of an oven.
Take that along to the inn.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.busy_2: Hold on, I'm in the middle of something.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.alms_fin: What a lovely thing to give. Bless you.
A dish like that for the poor? Bless you.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.inn_no_0: That's baker's work. Take it along to the bakery.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.inn_no_1: I don't buy baking here. The baker will.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.off_0: I only buy through the market, I'm sorry.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.spoilt_0: That batch is spoilt. I couldn't sell it to anyone.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.spoilt_1: Spoilt right through. No, I can't take that.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.gruel_0: That's gruel. The alms table will take it, not I.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.gruel_1: Gruel is for the poor. Take it to the alms table.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.mess_0: That's not a dish I can sell.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.mess_1: I can't do anything with that.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.carry_0: That's not a whole Mark yet. I'll keep the rest for your next.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.carry_1: Less than a Mark, that. I'll count it with the next.
say.guildmark.talk.kitchen.door.request_: That's the very dish I asked for. Thank you.
Just what the slate asked for. A little extra for you.
That's a special order, and I keep those for cooks I know.
I'll pay the usual for that. Special orders go to cooks I know better.
